lines.en: label rinspring1:
scene sky
It isn’t long until Ami starts blowing up my phone, because scissor angel forbid that I take a moment to myself in order to get my head straight.
lines.zh: 没过多久，Ami 就开始疯狂轰炸我的手机——毕竟剪刀天使保佑，我居然想给自己留一点时间理清头绪。

lines.en: But, now that my neck is broken and I can no longer look from side to side, it’s about time that I head out.
lines.zh: 不过，既然我的脖子已经断了，再也没法左右张望，那我也该动身了。

lines.en: I’m not sure when the next time I’ll be coming back here is. But one thing I {i}do{/i} know is that my presence will cause nothing but problems for everyone now.
lines.zh: 我不知道下一次回到这里会是什么时候。但我{i}明确{/i}知道一件事：如今我的存在，只会给大家带来麻烦。

lines.en: I know they’ll understand. And I know they’ll likely be hurt when I don’t wind up calling them, but how {i}could{/i} I when my hands shake every time I pick up my phone?
lines.zh: 我知道她们会理解的。我也知道，如果最后我没有给她们打电话，她们大概会伤心——可每次一拿起手机，我的手都在发抖，这让我{i}怎么{/i}打得出去？

lines.en: Her number is still in there. And I know that Ami would happily delete it if I asked her to, but I can’t bring myself to {i}do{/i} that because it’s the only thing I have left.
lines.zh: 她的号码还在里面。我知道只要我开口，Ami 会很乐意把它删掉，可我始终{i}做{/i}不到，因为那是我仅剩的东西了。

lines.en: I wonder who would answer if I were to call that number now. But I don’t wonder for long as I find more comfort pretending it would be the dulcet sound of an infinite dial tone.
lines.zh: 我在想，如果现在拨通那个号码，接的人会是谁。不过我没想太久，因为假装听筒里只会传来那悦耳的、无尽的拨号音，反而让我更安心。

lines.en: I want to grind this machine to pieces and swallow them like capsules so that I may consume and sacrifice everyone I know all at once.
lines.zh: 我想把这台机器碾成碎片，再像吞胶囊一样把它们吞下去，好让我一次性把我认识的每个人都吞下、献祭掉。

lines.en: Perhaps that’s what’s needed to carry on without destroying someone else.
lines.zh: 也许，这就是在不毁掉别人的前提下继续活下去所必须做的事。

lines.en: All other sacrificial means just seem far too exhausting now.
lines.zh: 而其他所有献祭的方式，如今看来都太累人了。

lines.en: I make my way through the courtyard.
lines.zh: 我穿过庭院。

lines.en: : Ah! There!
lines.zh: : 啊！在那儿！

lines.en: But I encounter a barbed tripwire that severs my feet from my body before hoisting me up into a cypress tree where I will be ultimately consumed by a plethora of hungry insects.
lines.zh: 可我撞上了一根带倒刺的绊线，它把我的双脚从身体上齐根切断，然后把我吊上一棵柏树，最后我将被一大群饥饿的昆虫啃食殆尽。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang1
: See? You all doubted my abilities to predict his actions, but I have played far too many otome games to not know where to find my favorite characters by now.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？你们全都怀疑我预判他行动的能力，可我玩过的乙女游戏实在太多了，不可能不知道该去哪儿找我最喜欢的角色。

lines.en: : Oh. It’s you guys.
lines.zh: : 哦。是你们啊。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be in class?
lines.zh: : 你们不该在上课吗？

lines.en: : We...we all decided to leave. And Miss Imai wasn’t opposed considering today’s...um...{i}circumstances.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们……我们都决定走了。而且考虑到今天的……呃……{i}情况{/i}，Imai 老师也没有反对。

lines.en: : Rin and Molly I’d expect this from. But not you, Futaba. You’re not the type to cut class. Get back in there and...learn things. Or whatever.
lines.zh: : Rin 和 Molly 会这么干，我一点也不意外。可你不会啊，Futaba。你不是会逃课的那种人。回去……好好学点东西。或者什么的。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang2
: What do you mean you’d expect that from me?! When have I ever cut class before?!
lines.zh: : 你说「对我一点也不意外」是什么意思？！我什么时候逃过课了？！

lines.en: : ‘Tis true that I have been known to skip school in favor of new releases from time to time. Mental health is important after all.
lines.zh: : 确实，我曾经为了新作发售偶尔翘过课。毕竟心理健康很重要。

lines.en: : Which...is a good thing to bring up after...everything we just heard from you in there...
lines.zh: : 这话……在你刚才在里面跟我们说了那些之后提出来……真是时候啊……

lines.en: : Ah, yes.
lines.zh: : 啊，是的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not doing so great right now. But it’s nothing you need to concern yourself with.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我现在状态不太好。不过这不是你们需要操心的事。

lines.en: : Uhh...it kind of {i}is,{/i} dude. This isn’t a thing we can just shrug off. Especially not with Ami on the verge of going fucking postal. I could have sworn Chika was about to slit her throat.
lines.zh: : 呃……这事我们还{i}真得{/i}操心，老兄。这不是耸耸肩就能翻篇的。尤其是 Ami 正处在快要他妈疯掉的边缘。我发誓 Chika 当时差点就要割了她的喉咙。

lines.en: : She did. I just finished cleaning up the blood. So, if you’ll please excuse me, I’ll be going home to take a shower now.
lines.zh: : 她确实割了。我刚把血清理完。那么，请恕我失陪，我现在要回家洗个澡。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang3
: Sensei, please don’t make jokes about this. We’re all really worried about you. And we get that you need some time off to handle things, but-
lines.zh: : Sensei，请别拿这件事开玩笑。我们都很担心你。我们也明白你需要一段时间来处理这些事，可是——

lines.en: : But we’re not really sure if that time should be with {i}Ami.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可我们不太确定，那段时间是不是该和 {i}Ami{/i} 一起过。

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to come stay with me, Sir. The Kendo Princess and I can share a bed while we wait out the duration of your debuffs.
lines.zh: : 您随时可以来我家住，先生。等您的减益效果结束的这段时间，我可以和剑道公主挤一张床。

lines.en: : You can...stay with me too...if you want...but...yeah...Ami is...
lines.zh: : 你也可以……住我那儿……如果你愿意……不过……是啊……Ami 她……

lines.en: : She seems kind of...not {i}safe{/i} right now...
lines.zh: : 她现在看起来有点……不太{i}安全{/i}……

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s exactly the issue. She’s going fucking insane and I’m literally the only person in the world who can do anything about it. And I owe her that much after she just looked after me for so long.
lines.zh: : 嗯，问题就在这里。她快要他妈疯了，而我真的是这个世界上唯一能对此做点什么的人。而且她照顾了我这么久，我欠她的就是这么多。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang4
: Well...what about Ayane? She’s known Ami long enough to be able to help with stuff like this, hasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 那么……Ayane 呢？她认识 Ami 够久了，应该能帮上忙吧？

lines.en: : There’s also-
lines.zh: : 还有——

lines.en: : There’s no one else. It has to be me.
lines.zh: : 没有别人了。必须是我。

lines.en: : And, to be honest, I probably should have noticed this coming and got her help a long time ago. But that would have required me actually {i}helping{/i} in some way, so of course I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我大概早该看出苗头，很久以前就让她去接受{i}帮{/i}助了。可那需要我真正去做点什么，所以我当然没有。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang5

: Now, hold the fuck up before you start going on some annoying rant about how “useless” you think you are. Because you’ve helped me with so much of my shit that I’ve legitimately lost track of it all.
lines.zh: : 喂，你他妈先给我等等，别又开启那套「我有多没用」的烦人长篇大论。因为你帮我处理过的破事实在太多了，多到我真的已经数不清了。

lines.en: : Me as well, Sir. Even if we’ve had our fair share of issues.
lines.zh: : 我也是，先生。哪怕我们之间也有过不少问题。

lines.en: : People say I’ve been...talking more lately and...I think all of that is thanks to you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 大家都说我最近……话变多了……而我觉得……那全都多亏了你，Sensei……

lines.en: scene rinandthegang6
: And I’ve talked about this subject so many times that I feel like I shouldn’t even bother you with it anymore...
lines.zh: : 这件事我说过太多次了，都觉得不该再拿它来烦你了……

lines.en: : Thanks, guys. I feel a lot better knowing that I’ve made positive impacts on all of you while ignoring the one girl who’s been under my nose this entire time.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们。知道自己给你们所有人都带来了正面的影响，却一直无视了那个从头到尾就在我眼皮底下的女孩，我感觉好多了。

lines.en: : You’re welcome!
lines.zh: : 不客气！

lines.en: : I think...that was sarcasm, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……那是反话，Rin……

lines.en: : Then you’re {i}not{/i} welcome! And you’re also obligated to come hang out with us right now so we can take {i}our{/i} turn to try and make you feel better! {i}Without{/i} locking you in your room!
lines.zh: : 那就{i}不{/i}用谢！而且你现在有义务跟{i}我们{/i}出去玩，好轮到我们来让你好受一点！这次{i}不{/i}把你锁在房间里！

lines.en: : While I may not entirely agree that time outside of one’s room is necessary to replenish one’s mana, I do believe Nithhala may be correct in recommending such a thing this time, Sir.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不完全认同「必须走出房间才能回补魔力」，但这一次，我认为 Nithhala 的建议可能是正确的，先生。

lines.en: : It might be a little selfish of us, but...we have a lot we’ve been wanting to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 我们可能有点自私，不过……我们有好多话一直想跟你说。

lines.en: : And you haven’t even commented on how awesome my new hair looks yet!
lines.zh: : 而且你还没夸过我的新发型有多赞呢！

lines.en: : Cool hair, Rin.
lines.zh: : 发型很酷，Rin。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang7
: Why thank you, Sensei. What a nice thing of you to say completely unprovoked.
lines.zh: : 哎呀谢谢您，Sensei。您居然会毫无预兆地说出这么好听的话。

lines.en: : You can...wait a little longer before...going back home, can’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你可以……晚一点再……回家吧？……

lines.en: : We’ve...already left school, so...it’s not like we have anything else to do now...and...there’s some stuff I want to talk to you about too...so...
lines.zh: : 我们……已经从学校出来了，所以……反正现在也没别的事可做……而且……我也有些话想跟你说……所以……

lines.en: : And none of this can wait the indeterminate amount of time it will take for me to leave my house again?
lines.zh: : 这些事就都不能等到我下次踏出家门那个遥遥无期的时刻再说？

lines.en: : We inch closer to death every minute. And so we must savor the few opportunities we have to bond with one another!
lines.zh: : 我们每分钟都在向死亡靠近。所以我们必须珍惜这为数不多的、能彼此交心的机会！

lines.en: scene rinandthegang8
: Because you never know when the person you love is going to leave you and you don’t want to regret not saying certain things that you probably wish you would have said.
lines.zh: : 因为你永远不知道你爱的人什么时候会离开你，而你不想后悔——不想把那些你本该说出口的话咽回去。

lines.en: : Subtle.
lines.zh: : 真含蓄。

lines.en: : Right...you and Otoha broke up. How are you holding up?
lines.zh: : 对了……你和 Otoha 分手了。你还好吗？

lines.en: scene rinandthegang9
: I kissed Sana.
lines.zh: : 我亲了 Sana。

lines.en: : Hahah......hah.....
: I feel like the old me would have said something like, “I wish I was there to see it.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得以前的我大概会说类似「真希望我当时在场亲眼看看」的话。

lines.en: : Then...what would the new one say?
lines.zh: : 那……现在的你会说什么？

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想去死。

lines.en: : Maybe we should invite Miss Watabe too then? You guys have that in common. Maybe she can help?
lines.zh: : 那我们要不要把 Watabe 老师也请来？你们俩有这个共同点。也许她能帮上忙？

lines.en: : I think she’s mad at me right now. And again, I’m not hanging out with you guys.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她现在在生我的气。再说一遍，我不会跟你们出去玩。

lines.en: : Sure you are. You can shower and get Ami’s blood off of you later. It’s only fair that you come with us now since we were the ones to find you.
lines.zh: : 你会的。你身上的 Ami 的血可以晚点再洗。既然是我们找到你的，你现在跟我们走才算公平。

lines.en: : We kind of...branched off into teams and...chose different areas outside of the school to wait for you in.
lines.zh: : 我们算是……分成了几组……各自选了校外的不同地方等你。

lines.en: : They all doubted me when I suggested the side entrance. But if there’s anything I know about Irish goodbyes, it’s that the back is far more conspicuous from the front. Not a sex joke.
lines.zh: : 我提议守侧门的时候，她们都怀疑我。不过要说我对「爱尔兰式告别」有什么了解，那就是从正面看，后面反而更显眼。这不是色情笑话。

lines.en: : It would have been a terrible one if it was.
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，那也是个烂透了的笑话。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang10
: I may be a comedic relief character, but I’ve never claimed to be funny, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我也许是个负责搞笑的角色，可我从来没说过自己很幽默，先生。

lines.en: : You’ll...come with us right?...Just...for a little while?...
lines.zh: : 你会……跟我们一起来的对吧？……就……待一小会儿？……

lines.en: : Ami’s called me a million times, Sana. She needs me.
lines.zh: : Ami 给我打了一百万次电话了，Sana。她需要我。

lines.en: : Well...have you answered any of those calls yet?
lines.zh: : 那个……那些电话你接过吗？

lines.en: : Then...if you haven’t...doesn’t that mean you...{i}don’t{/i} want to see her?...
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你没接……这不就意味着你……{i}不{/i}想见她吗？……

lines.en: : Just say your phone died! Then we can all go hang out at the cafe for an hour or two and Ami won’t be able to get mad because...you can’t control electricity?
lines.zh: : 就说你手机没电了！那我们就可以一起去咖啡厅待上一两个小时，Ami 也没法生气，因为……你控制不了电？

lines.en: scene rinandthegang11
: Pweeeeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求————你了嘛？

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: scene rinandthegang12
: Pweeeeeeeeeease?......
: God, you’re good at that.
lines.zh: : 天啊，你真会来这套。

lines.en: : Oh, he’s done for now. There’s no denying that face.
lines.zh: : 哦，他现在完了。那张脸没法拒绝。

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : Pwetty pweeeeeeease?...We wub you...
lines.zh: : 求求你了嘛？……我们爱你……

lines.en: : What has happened to you in the two months I’ve been gone?
lines.zh: : 我不在的这两个月里，你到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene rinandthegang13
: A lot.
lines.zh: : 很多事。

lines.en: : God damn it. My nose is bleeding again, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 该死。我的鼻子又在流血了，对吧？

lines.en: scene rinandthegang14
: It appears that our only course of action now is to take Rin to the cafe so we can fix her nosebleed.
lines.zh: : 看来我们现在唯一的行动方案，就是把 Rin 带到咖啡厅去止住她的鼻血。

lines.en: : Don’t let me die, Dad. I’m too young to leave this world.
lines.zh: : 别让我死啊，老爸。我还太年轻，不能离开这个世界。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang15
: LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOOOOO!
: An excellent choice, Sir!
lines.zh: : 明智的选择，先生！

lines.en: scene black
: To the zeppelin! Thunder Bluff awaits!
lines.zh: : 向飞艇进发！雷霆崖在等着我们！

lines.en: : How about we walk instead? It’ll be faster.
lines.zh: : 我们走着去怎么样？那样更快。

lines.en: : Aspect of the pack, on! Go, go, go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 兽群守护，开！冲、冲、冲、冲、冲！

lines.en: Molly is the only one who takes off running, leaving the rest of us to follow behind her at a speed much more suited to my current status as an unmotivated sack of shit.
lines.zh: 只有 Molly 一个人撒腿就跑，剩下的人只能跟在她后面，用一种更适合我当下「毫无动力的废物」状态的速度前进。

lines.en: I don’t want to do this.
lines.zh: 我不想这么做。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: I don’t want to see Ami right now either.
lines.zh: 我现在也不想见 Ami。

lines.en: I just want to sleep.
lines.zh: 我只想睡觉。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang16
But a liquid barrier between that one goal and me is placed on the table just inches from my trembling hands and I realize just how far away sleep is.
lines.zh: 可就在我颤抖的双手前几英寸的桌面上，摆上了一道横在我和那唯一目标之间的液体屏障，我这才意识到，睡眠离我有多远。

lines.en: And while I want to approach this meeting just as I’d approach a dream-
lines.zh: 虽然我想用对待一场梦的方式，来面对这场聚会——

lines.en: scene rinandthegang17
In my dreams, there’s someone else.
lines.zh: 在我的梦里，还有别的人。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang16
: Hey...you good? Still with us?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你还好吗？还在我们这边吗？

lines.en: : Huh?
: Oh. Yeah. Sorry. Mind just wandered a bit.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯。抱歉。刚刚有点走神。

lines.en: : When that...happens to you...what’s it like?
lines.zh: : 你……那样的时候……是什么感觉？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...you kind of, like...black out sometimes...don’t you? Are you...seeing anything when that happens?...Or is it kind of like...everything just...you know...stops or something?
lines.zh: : 就是……你有时候会……会……突然断片……对吧？那发生的时候……你会看到什么吗？……还是说就像……一切都……你懂的……停住了什么的？

lines.en: : A little of both, actually. I think. But I rarely ever remember anything I see once I’m brought back to reality.
lines.zh: : 其实两者都有吧。我想。可一旦被拉回现实，我几乎从不记得自己看到过什么。

lines.en: : That’s unfortunate. Not remembering means you can’t even channel those visions into something creative. And I’ve heard that helps a great deal when it comes to battling stress.
lines.zh: : 那真可惜。记不住，就意味着你没法把那些画面转化成什么有创造力的东西。而我听说，这对抗压很有帮助。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think this is a little worse than just “stress.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得这要比「压力」严重一点。

lines.en: : Sounds like an interesting power to me, Sir. Almost like time-hopping. You get to slip through the cracks in reality without remembering any of the terrible things you see within them.
lines.zh: : 在我听来，这倒像是个有意思的能力，先生。几乎就像时间跳跃。你可以从现实的裂缝里滑过去，却不必记住在裂缝里看到的那些可怕的东西。

lines.en: : I get what you’re saying, though. When my depression kicks in, it’s often like I’m blocking out entire days or...weeks as a whole.
lines.zh: : 不过我懂你的意思。我的抑郁发作的时候，常常就像我把整整几天……甚至几周都屏蔽掉了。

lines.en: : Everything just kind of stops. And it doesn’t pick back up until something pulls me out of it. It just sucks extra hard because the only thing that really {i}can{/i} pull me out of it is time.
lines.zh: : 一切就好像停住了。除非有什么东西把我拉出来，否则它不会重新启动。而这事格外操蛋，因为唯一真的{i}能{/i}把我拉出来的东西，就是时间。

lines.en: : So it’s like getting caught in some mini paradox where you need to rely on time to heal, but you have no idea how much time is actually passing because you’ve lost all touch with it. You know what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 所以就像陷进了一个小小的悖论：你得靠时间来痊愈，可你完全不知道到底过去了多少时间，因为你已经和时间的感觉彻底脱节了。你懂我意思吗？

lines.en: : Almost too well.
lines.zh: : 懂得不能再懂了。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang18
: Really? Because I feel like that explanation barely scratched the surface of how it actually {i}feels.{/i} But I get that our situations are different.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为我觉得这番解释连它真正{i}感受{/i}的边都没摸到。不过我也明白，我们的处境不一样。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m sure you have no shortage of issues yourself right now, though. And I’m sorry I wasn’t around to help you with your breakup situation.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我相信你自己现在也有不少麻烦。还有，抱歉你分手那阵子我不在，没能帮你。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang19
: Don’t be. I have Futaba to help with that stuff.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。这种事有 Futaba 帮我。

lines.en: : All things considered, Rin handled herself surprisingly well after the first few days. She’s just...still a little bitter. But I’m sure that will go away in time.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，过了头几天之后，Rin 表现得意外地好。她只是……还有点苦涩。不过我相信时间会带走它。

lines.en: : Probably not, to be honest. I’ve heard that most people never get over the unwelcome shattering of their first love.
lines.zh: : 老实说，大概不会。我听说大多数人永远都走不出初恋被硬生生打碎的阴影。

lines.en: : Just kiss Sana a few more times and I’m sure it’ll start to go away.
lines.zh: : 再多亲 Sana 几次，我保证它就会开始消退了。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang20
: Weirdly enough, that didn’t do as much for me as I thought it would. So either I’ve ruled out being an exhibitionist, or I just see Sana as more of a friend than sex practice.
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，那件事的效果远没有我想的那么大。所以要么我已经排除了自己是个暴露狂的可能，要么就是我只把 Sana 当朋友，而不是练性的对象。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin...I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Rin……我很感激你这么说。

lines.en: : Yeah, don’t mention it. I just figured it would have been a little more exciting for me considering how many times I’ve fantasized about- I’m going to shut up now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别客气。我只是以为，考虑到我曾经幻想过多少次——算了，我现在就闭嘴。

lines.en: : At least you {i}got{/i} to kiss somebody. Miss Imai rejected me even harder than you did.
lines.zh: : 至少你还{i}亲到{/i}了谁。Imai 老师拒绝我的方式比你还要狠。

lines.en: : Well hey, at least you didn’t force yourself on her. Just look at how much you’ve grown in such a short amount of time.
lines.zh: : 嘿，至少你没有硬上她。看看你这么短的时间里成长了多少。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang21
: As it turns out, you receive quite the XP boost after having your heart broken. So at least you have leveling up to look forward to now, Rin.
lines.zh: : 事实证明，心碎之后能拿到相当可观的经验值加成。所以至少你现在还能期待升级，Rin。

lines.en: : May your next kiss with a classmate be one that you remember for the rest of your overwhelmingly lesbian life.
lines.zh: : 愿你下一次和同学的亲吻，能成为你余下那压倒性同性恋的人生里，铭记终生的一吻。

lines.en: : And may yours be consensual.
lines.zh: : 也愿你那一吻是你情我愿的。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang22
: Apart from the breakup and the Christmas party, there isn’t much you’ve missed. Well, other than Miss Imai slowly descending into madness. But we were all kind of doing that, so...
lines.zh: : 除了分手和圣诞派对，你错过的事不多。哦，还有 Imai 老师正慢慢滑向疯狂。不过我们大家多少都在这么干，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah...she’s made it pretty obvious...just how much she likes you lately...
lines.zh: : 嗯……她最近……把自己有多喜欢你表现得相当明显……

lines.en: : And she had the...great misfortune of drawing your name for Secret Santa. So I’m sure she’s pretty upset that she wasn’t able to give you anything on account of your...yeah.
lines.zh: : 而且她……不幸得很，在秘密圣诞老人里抽到了你的名字。所以她没能送出礼物，肯定相当难过，因为你的……嗯。

lines.en: : You guys still put me on the list despite me being completely MIA for two months?
lines.zh: : 我都整整失踪两个月了，你们还把我留在名单上？

lines.en: scene rinandthegang23
: Heck yeah, we did. We believed in you the whole time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那当然了。我们自始至终都相信你，Sensei。

lines.en: : We knew you’d be back eventually. The tough part was just waiting out your absence since we’re all {i}way{/i} more dependent on you than we thought!
lines.zh: : 我们知道你总有一天会回来。难熬的只是等你的那段时间，因为我们对你的依赖{i}远{/i}比自己以为的要深！

lines.en: : Everyone else, maybe. But you seemed to fare pretty well on your own for the...complete duration of your relationship.
lines.zh: : 别人也许是吧。可在你整段恋情期间，你看起来一个人也过得挺好。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang24
: But deep down, my heart was screaming, “Sensei! Sensei!”
lines.zh: : 可在内心深处，我的心一直在呐喊：「Sensei！Sensei！」

lines.en: : Cute. But it doesn’t mean much when your actual voice is screaming someone else’s name.
lines.zh: : 真可爱。可当你真正的声音喊的是别人的名字时，这就没什么意义了。

lines.en: scene rinandthegang25
: I will not sit here and be blamed for the specific words that escape my mouth at the peak of this very hormonal time in my life.
lines.zh: : 我可不会坐在这里，为我在这段荷尔蒙爆棚的人生时刻里脱口而出的具体字眼负责。

lines.en: : But I {i}will{/i} sit here and inform you that that time is over and that we can now go back to being the best homies who ever homied because I suddenly have way more free time on my hands.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}要{/i}坐在这里告诉你，那个时期已经结束了，我们现在可以重新做回史上最铁的哥们儿，因为我突然多了大把的空闲时间。

lines.en: : And I suddenly have almost none.
lines.zh: : 而我突然几乎没有空闲了。

lines.en: : What do you mean you have none? You’re taking a hiatus from school. That should mean you have plenty of extra time on your hands now.
lines.zh: : 什么叫几乎没有？你休学了啊。那应该意味着你现在有大把多出来的时间才对。

lines.en: : Unless you’re joining a men’s softball league or something.
lines.zh: : 除非你要去参加什么男子垒球联盟之类的。

lines.en: : Why would...what?
lines.zh: : 我为什么……什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s just the first thing my mind went to in my seemingly endless mental battle to not think about Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。只是在我那场为了不去想 Otoha 而进行的、看似无休无止的内心战役里，这是我脑子里蹦出的第一个念头。

lines.en: : I’m...not joining a softball league. I just can’t imagine being in the mood to do {i}anything{/i} in the near future as just moving my body is a chore right now.
lines.zh: : 我……不会去参加垒球联盟。我只是无法想象近期自己会有心情去做{i}任何事{/i}，光是挪动身体现在就已经是一件苦差事了。

lines.en: : Damn. I guess softball really is out of the question then, huh?
lines.zh: : 靠。那看来垒球是真的没戏了，哈？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s...a problem if you stay at home, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你待在家里……不算什么问题，Sensei……

lines.en: scene rinandthegang26
: I’d just...like to be able to visit you every now and then...
lines.zh: : 我只是……希望能时不时去看看你……

lines.en: : All of us would. But, given Ami’s current...{i}condition,{/i} maybe it would be best to wait a little while before introducing the idea to her?
lines.zh: : 我们都会的。不过考虑到 Ami 目前的……{i}状况{/i}，也许最好等一阵子再跟她提这个主意？

lines.en: : I’ve got plenty of new games for you to not be interested in, Sir. I’d love to come share them with you.
lines.zh: : 我有好多新游戏等着你提不起兴趣呢，先生。我很乐意带过去和你分享。

lines.en: : Again, thank you guys.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你们。

lines.en: scene black
: But I’ve got bigger fish to add to my hot pot right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在有更大的鱼要下进我的火锅里。

lines.en: : That’s...That’s not how that phrase normally goes, is it?
lines.zh: : 那句……那句话通常不是这么说的吧？

lines.en: : Ooooh hot pot sounds good. Let’s have a hot pot party soon. This place called FoodCo. just opened that-
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦火锅听着不错。我们很快办个火锅派对吧。有家叫 FoodCo. 的店刚开业，那——

lines.en: The rest of our outing carries on normally.
lines.zh: 我们这次外出剩下的时间，一切如常。

lines.en: My phone continues to burn holes in my pocket.
lines.zh: 我的手机继续在我的口袋里烧出洞来。
